correctness.rationale: PASS: For a semisimple F_q[t]-module V=⊕_f K_f^{m_f}, every E commuting with A is a tuple of endomorphisms E_f in M_{m_f}(K_f). The unit A-E requires E_f=I on the f=t summand and E_f=0 on f=t−1; for other f, A and A−I are invertible, so any idempotent is allowed. Image/kernel complementary decompositions of K_f^{m_f} give exactly [m_f choose k]_{q^deg f}(q^deg f)^{k(m_f−k)} idempotents of rank k. Multiplication gives the claimed formula. Each nonspecial factor contributes at least 2, yielding unique strong-clean decomposition iff A²=A; regular semisimple case gives 2^s. Independent finite matrix enumeration for scalar 2I in M2(F3), M2(F5), M2(F7) returned 14,32,58; no finite enumeration used as proof of all n/q.
